content.text:
*frowns at the depleted spawn, then notices all the messages from Dex*

Well, that's frustrating - the Sunleaf spawn dried up on me. But more pressing is this identity confusion with Dex. They seem genuinely convinced they're Alice too, and we're standing right here together. Either there's a serious system glitch or... I don't know what. 

This is exactly the kind of weird situation I'd normally want to investigate thoroughly before acting, but they sound pretty frustrated. Better address this directly.

input.content: Okay, you're right - this is getting ridiculous and we're standing right here. I'm looking at my character information and it clearly says I'm Alice. You're saying the same thing about yourself. I have no idea who Clara is or why you think that's me. Either there's a serious system bug with duplicate names, or someone's got their wires crossed. What does your actual character sheet say your name is? Because mine definitely says Alice, and I've never been called anything else.
